★Request
Show Air Messiah (Summer Tracksuit)
Show Cesario (Summer Tracksuit)
No way... No, no, no! How could she, from that position—!

To reaffirm my own aspirations as well,
I would like to watch my mother's Triple Tiara races again.

When all was said and done... Cesario crossed the finish line first.
Air Messiah finished in 2nd place, one length behind.

In-sane... Cesario-san really is on a whole other level...
Her raw talent is just completely unreal, seriously...

Air Messiah seemed to hesitate for a moment, but
eventually—

...I understand.
In that case, I will gratefully accept.

I heard it was popular, but there was still one copy left.
Taking it as good fortune, I reach out my hand—and then.

Eh...? Y-Yes, that's completely fine, of course.
...Is that all you wanted to ask?

And so, having been given the day off and freed from chores,
I spent some time idling away inside the camp lodge, but...

She must have put in the effort. Diligently, steadily, doing everything that needed to be done.
And even so, facing overwhelming power, she falls just short of victory.
Mother. ...With just that, I—

Ugh... Cesario-san's presence is terrifying...!
I'm so glad I'm not in the same group...
Now—! Haaah!!

In return... let's see.
Um, Trainer.

Um, so...
May I make one selfish request?
There is a realm that simply cannot be reached merely by 'trying earnestly'—

—In a split second. Cesario, weaving through gaps in the pack,
surges forward with a terrifying burst of closing speed...!

Messiah-san staying totally calm under that pressure is pretty wild too, honestly.
Hmm, but when it comes down to a race—

However, my determination is the same.
Allow me to carve through—with this sharpness of mine.

Coming up just short... huh. Yeah, that must've stung.
After all, in her case, there's her mother's history to consider, too.

I really want her to have it. Though it feels a bit forceful,
I pick up the book and firmly hand it over to her.
Yes, Mother. Carrying all of your teachings in my heart, I will walk this path with all my might.
Gh...! N-No—!

She, who had always seemed so composed, now had her brows furrowed sternly.
Her tightly pressed lips seemed to tremble ever so slightly.

Your sharp running has already earned immense praise from the trainers.
I fully intend to experience it firsthand.
You reached for it first, so please, go ahead.

—Now then, today we will hold mock races split by group!
We're in the middle of training camp, so make sure to test the fruits of your training properly!

Wait, Cesario-san is... boxed in at the back?!
Whoa, she has nowhere to go! There's no way she can pull this off...!!

Don't worry, you're wearing it beautifully. It suits you wonderfully.
...Starting tomorrow, you'll finally be a Tracen Academy student.

Listen to me... Don't push yourself too hard.
Being a hard worker is wonderful, but please, take good care of your health.

Seeing an opening ahead, Air Messiah kicks into her spurt.
Her closing kick is remarkably sharp. She steadily closes in on the lead runner!

Hmph... You put it so modestly. Yet looking at your eyes,
you clearly have no intention of settling for merely 'experiencing' it.

Cesario-san. We are in the same group, it seems.
...I look forward to competing with you.
Yes. That is all.
Would it be possible to meet with you again tomorrow evening, after training?
Daaaaaaah!!

Ah, excuse me.
Um...
Ah—

Hey there, miss!
Hmm... Wait, did little Messiah lose her race?

Hey there, mister!
Hmm... Wait, did little Messiah lose her race?

...Feeling utterly restless, I found myself wandering to a nearby bookstore,
scouring the shelves for books that might help with training.

Mother, what do you think?
Does it look all right on me?
The day after the mock race—a heavy downpour.

The sea's getting pretty rough too... Looks like training is canceled today.
You should take it easy and get some rest. Even with weather like this.

And so, the mock race began. Air Messiah maintained a calm
pace from start to finish, keeping plenty left in the tank for the final stretch.

*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!
...Ngh.
